propositions: The structured-output extraction system returns the first parseable JSON object in model replies, causing quoted examples and tool results to masquerade as the intended payload when they appear before the real response

Repeated fixes to the extraction logic are broken by routine model provider changes (e.g. Bedrock cutover), indicating the root cause is model-agnostic and requires systematic hardening rather than instance-level patching

Provider-native structured output must be gated on measured safety per model rather than blanket assumptions, and Bedrock requires SDK floor upgrade (botocore >= 1.43) to support client-side outputConfig
The prompted path requires an explicit sentinel output channel whose directive and extraction ship atomically, with schema-filtered candidate selection using last-valid-wins to avoid decoy matches
Raw-reply artifacts must be available on parse failure as an opt-in, replayable diagnostic mechanism (default off) to support observability and re-evaluation
A deterministic, reusable provider-matrix baseline/eval harness running as a manual CI job is needed to measure before/after raw-output distributions and validate provider capability claims
